Man Builds a Sturdy House by Inflating Plastic?! Korea’s Dome House Built Like LEGO

Hello, this is King Process.
The biggest advantages of the Wisdome House featured in this video are its fast installation and versatility.
Because the panels are prefabricated in a factory and connected on-site like LEGO blocks, the house can be installed quickly without complicated equipment. It can also be disassembled and relocated when needed, while additional panels can be connected to expand the space.
Made from high-density polyethylene, or HDPE, the panels resist moisture and impact and do not corrode easily. Insulation inside the panels helps block outdoor heat and cold while maintaining a comfortable indoor temperature. The plastic material is also recyclable.
A transparent roof and large panoramic windows allow plenty of natural light and outdoor views. The dome house can be used for campgrounds, accommodations, rest areas, temporary housing, and many other purposes.
